# Apheron

> Apheron (apheron.io) is Francesco Perone's personal periodical: a hand-made index
> of the websites he has built, for himself and for others. English and Italian.
> No frameworks, no tracking, no cookies.

## Chapters

- [Albania & Montenegro](https://apheron.io/albania-trip/): road-trip diary, August 2026
- [Home Assistant](https://apheron.io/home-assistant): private couple's app (login required)
- [Italian Lessons in Dublin](https://apheron.io/italian-lessons-dublin/): teaching project, 2025 (archive)
- [Chiara Caruso, nanny](https://apheron.io/tata-chiara-caruso): commissioned site, Prato
- [Studio Legale Taiti](https://apheron.io/avvocato_carlotta_taiti): commissioned site, Prato
- [L.A. Mason Group](https://apheron.io/lamasongroup/): commissioned site, Florence
- [Studio Biancalani](https://www.studiobiancalani.it/): commissioned site, now on its own domain
